mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Community Park under a full moon. There is an ISS pass tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is currently reviewing development proposals for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, including plans for Ardent Glen and 1979 Milky Way. Also, remember that property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15th.

Today you can attend Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow is packed with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, don't miss the Main Street Trick or Treat on October 29th and live music at Bailey's Run on October 30th.
In a report from October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. No students were injured during the incident.
Culver's of Verona is featuring the Pumpkin Pecan flavor of the day today, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
